bullets.text: New Leadership at Ontix - **Chris Newall** appointed as CEO to enhance connectivity across UK communities.
5G Standalone Milestone - **Virgin Media O2** celebrates its 5G Standalone network now live in 500 UK locations.
Collaboration for Fibre Growth - The UK’s fibre future relies on industry collaboration to meet diverse connectivity needs.
Cisco's Digital Commitment - **Cisco** emphasizes inclusive connectivity and ethical AI to support UK's digital transformation.
Major AI Infrastructure Investment - **Nscale** plans UK's largest AI supercomputer to support enterprise AI needs.
AI Growth Zone in North East - New initiative aims to create 5,000 jobs and attract £30 billion in investment.
Gigaclear Innovates with AI - First retail fibre provider to use **Vyntelligence** AI technology for rural broadband installations.
Private 5G Market Growth - The private 5G market is nearing mainstream adoption with significant industrial interest.
Fibre Quality Essential - Upgrading existing networks is crucial to meet rising demand for high-speed broadband.
Lit Fibre Launches New Services - **Lit Fibre** introduces high-speed broadband options tailored for businesses.
